title: Per queste tue manine
subtitle: Zerlina and Leporello: duet from Don Giovanni, Act 2 (No. 21b, Vienna 1788)

passages.label: Per queste tue manine · abbi pietà di me
Non v'è pietà, briccone · Ah, di fuggir si provi · Sei morto se ti movi
Barbari, ingiusti Dei · Barbaro traditore · Deh non mi stringer tanto
Sen vada, o resti · Che strette, oh Dei · Di gioja e di diletto · così si fa
Sei morto (second time) · Deh non mi stringer · Sen vada · Che strette (second time)
Di gioja e di diletto (second time) · Che buja oscurità · così si fa (to the end)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (movi for muovi, quà, gioja, buja, ovver, oh Dei; the score's repeats).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 225–232, bars 1–96 of No. 21b
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker; a third, independent transcription was compared with it and every difference settled on the print. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Allegro moderato, 4/4, 96 full bars; bars 94–96 are for the piano alone. Playback tempo: ♩ = 117, about 3:17, from the median of four complete recordings of the duet (Östman 1989 3:23, Norrington 1992 3:19, Gardiner 1994 3:15, Jacobs 2006 3:13); the duet is often left out of performances and recordings, and only recordings that include it whole were used. Mozart gives the words Allegro moderato only.
